messages:
ana: kicking off A/B canary for v4.1-int8 (A=fp32 v4.0, B=int8 v4.1) at 6% traffic. objective: validate long-context QA fidelity + latency/cost tradeoff. will run 3h.
jihoon: quick sim summary: median token-cost -28%, p95 latency -18%, but longctx QA F1 drops ~0.9% on aggregate. need policy for automated gating.
karen: noticed B has higher variance on extremely long prompts; bootstrap CI shows wider tails vs A. might be sampling noise for small slices.
max: infra note: int8 initial KV cold misses higher, steady state after ~35m. recommend warmup window before auto decisions.
ana: (typo) ana: proposing a confidence-aware rollback: only trigger auto-fallback when relative metric delta and its 95% bootstrap CI both exceed thresholds. e.g., rel F1 drop >1.0% AND CI lower bound >0.4%. this avoids single-window flukes.
jihoon: like that. also add hysteresis: require two consecutive windows (5m) meeting condition, or one window if it crosses a critical slice threshold.
karen: define critical slices = auth, billing, legal-search. for those, set rel F1 threshold 0.5% and CI lower bound >0.2%, and allow immediate rollback after 1 window.
max: warmup_mins = 40. during warmup emit alerts but suppress auto actions. ops wants stepdown rollback to minimize queue storms: 60%->20%->0 over 3m.
nana: include sample floor n>=150 for any automated action. tiny-sample slices are noisy.
jihoon: also add a drift timer: if canary runs >90m, tighten thresholds by factor 0.85 to catch slow regressions.
karen: draft config (string blob): ```json
{"auto_fallback":"true","method":"bootstrap_ci","rel_f1_threshold_default":"0.01","ci_lower_bound_default":"0.004","rel_f1_threshold_critical":"0.005","ci_lower_bound_critical":"0.002","hysteresis_windows":"2","window_mins":"5","warmup_mins":"40","sample_floor":"150","stepdown_rollout":"60,20,0","stepdown_duration_mins":"3","tighten_after_mins":"90","tighten_factor":"0.85"}
```
max: ops: route alerts to #canary-ops with a pinned summary card but mute non-critical slice chatter. ensure rollback backfill routes to pinned fp32 v4.0.
nana: one more: prefer using moving median over mean for noisy metrics, especially longctx F1. reduces sensitivity to outliers.
jihoon: agreed. action items: Karen finalize slice list + critical thresholds; Max implement warmup + stepdown rollback; Ana and Jihoon will add bootstrap CI gating to canary monitor. reconvene after 3h smoke.
ops-bot: canary started at 4901239876 -> 6% traffic. dashboard: https://console/redwood/canary/4901239876
ana: thanks team. :rocket:
